name: Ticrynafen

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in United States and 4 other countries, first in 1980 — for liver harm

summary: Ticrynafen was removed from the market in the United States and four other countries starting in 1980 because it caused liver harm [3]. In addition, results from a small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave the drug a medium liver risk score of 60 [M]. The same computer model also gave the drug a low heart risk score of 20 [M].
